newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KLTC to seek 5,000 tonnes of pork.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KLTC to seek 5,000 tonnes of pork.

text.p: Korea Livestock Trading Corp (KLTC) said on Friday it will invite tenders for 5,000 tonnes of frozen pork by 11.00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Wednesday.
An KLTC official said it was a part of a South Korean government plan to buy 20,000 tonnes of pork.
South Korea said last Friday it would buy the pork in January to ease domestic pork prices, which are hovering at around 173,000 won per 100 kg, up from 133,000 won a year ago.

The official said the purchase was in addition to South Korea's obligation to buy 14,620 tonnes this year under the Minimum Market Access (MMA) requirement of the World Trade Organisation. Acceptable origins were set for the United States, Canada, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Japan, Taiwan, New Zealand, Australia, Finland, and the Netherlands, he said.
The tender was divided in two positions; each position was 2,500 tonnes to Seoul and Pusan.
The tenders are for short-ribbed pork belly.
